long_biography.plain_text:
Clyde Fakhoury entered PFO Côte d’Ivoire’s management in 2008. Over the next eleven years he served as a director and deputy general manager, a progression that led to the management of PFO Africa by 2022. The succession placed an experienced second-generation executive at the head of a business whose roots predated his own career.

His public work spans particular projects rather than a single discipline. Fakhoury has represented the group at the opening of the Mé drinking-water plant and the Abobo road tunnel. He also attended the launch of a flood-control scheme in Lomé and solar-energy partnerships in northern Côte d’Ivoire. At a graduation ceremony, he told students from a professional master’s programme that its purpose was to prepare future leaders for major construction projects.
